alphaMethod: Exact positive texel-box overlap area under source=origin+asset*scale, measured independently per16x16 cell. A1/9/128/200/245 all reported. No interpolation, clipping by other scene objects, or GPU rendered visibility claimed.
groundMethod: Unchanged 759 visible stone-foot polyline plus explicit NEW hidden rear corner, from preceding whole-base report; never substitute alpha or old audit polygon.
limits: Per-cell positive ground area does not mean the full cell is filled.
Projected roof/body pixels do not certify foundation, collision or all original physical responsibility.
Coarse overlapping audit ownership is a clue only, not certified neighboring ground support.
